title: 基本操作｜linked list：加入、刪除、走訪
question:
跟上一題一樣用 struct Node（int val、Node* next）和指到第一個節點的 head 做 linked list，支援三種指令：
1 x：用 new 建立一個存 x 的節點，放到串列的最前面
2 x：刪掉第一個存 x 的節點（前一個節點的 next 改成指到它的下一個，再用 delete 把它還回去）；找不到就輸出 Not found!
3：從 head 開始走到 nullptr，每個數字各輸出一行；串列是空的就輸出 Empty!
第一行輸入 N，接下來輸入 N 個指令。
提示：刪除時要改的可能是 head，也可能是前一個節點的 next。用一個指標的指標 Node** pp 指到「要改的那個指標」：一開始 pp = &head，往後走就是 pp = &(*pp)->next，找到之後改 *pp 就好，不用分開處理。

test_case.note: 刪掉第一個 5（就是 head 指到的那個）
唯一的節點刪掉之後又是空的
刪中間的 2，再刪最後面的 1

en.title: Basics | linked list: add, delete, walk
en.question:
Like the last problem, make a linked list with struct Node (int val, Node* next) and a pointer head to the first node. It supports three commands:
1 x: make a node holding x with new, and put it at the front
2 x: delete the first node holding x (the next of the node before it now points to the node after it, then give it back with delete). If there is none, output Not found!
3: walk from head to nullptr and output each number on its own line. If the list is empty, output Empty!
First input N, then N commands.
Hint: when you delete, the pointer to change may be head or the next of the node before. Use a pointer to a pointer, Node** pp, that points to the pointer to change: start with pp = &head, move on with pp = &(*pp)->next, and when you find it, change *pp. Then head needs no special case.

test_case.note: Delete the first 5 (the one head points to)
After deleting the only node it is empty again
Delete 2 in the middle, then 1 at the end
